colorPicker.eyedropperBody: The eyedropper uses the native window.EyeDropper API (Chromium-based browsers). It is automatically hidden in browsers that do not support it.
colorPicker.value: Controlled color value (any of the supported formats).
colorPicker.onValueChange: Fired on every change. Receives the formatted string and a parsed color object with all formats.
colorPicker.onFormatChange: Fired when the user switches format.
colorPicker.swatches: Optional preset swatches. When omitted, the strip is hidden.
colorPicker.hideEyedropper: Force-hide the eyedropper button (it is automatically hidden in unsupported browsers).
colorPicker.triggerLabel: Optional label rendered alongside the color tile.
colorPicker.triggerLabelPosition: Position of the label relative to the color tile.
colorPicker.triggerShowValue: Show the hex value (without alpha) next to the tile.
colorPicker.triggerShowRemove: Render an X button on the trigger.
colorPicker.onTriggerRemove: Fired when the X button is clicked.
colorPicker.triggerClassName: Custom classes on the trigger button.
colorPicker.forwardedProps: All ColorPicker props are forwarded to the panel.
